purpose: Train one relation-identity-independent semantic matcher on many runtime schema meanings before Production operator learning, then freeze it so six core relations cannot become an implicit ontology and unseen runtime descriptions cannot be destroyed by P2 optimization.

relation_train.description: The source work was written or composed by the target person or organization.
The source entity is situated or found at the target place.
The source quantity or phenomenon is measured using the target instrument or method.
The source text explicitly refers to or cites the target item.
The source text condenses the main content of the target material.
The source reproduces words or a passage from the target.
The source item is assigned the target label or category name.
The source model or statement forecasts the target outcome.
The source event or signal was observed during the target interval or activity.
heldout_phrases: was seen in the course of

relation_train.description: The source work was published or issued by the target organization.
The source component or hypothesis was tested using the target method or apparatus.
The source data or artifact is stored in the target repository or medium.
The source content is visually presented on the target interface or device.
The source text names or mentions the target without asserting a stronger relation.
The source expression or document is translated into the target language or representation.
heldout_phrases: is expressed in the target language

relation_train.description: The source participant exchanges messages or signals with the target participant.

relation_holdout.description: The source claim, result, or artifact was checked and verified by the target procedure or reviewer.
The source traffic, request, or flow passes through the target intermediary.
The source item was bought or acquired from the target seller.
The source activity is scheduled to occur after the target activity.
phrases: is planned for a time following

relation_holdout.description: The source event or measurement was recorded by the target device or observer.
The source item occurs or appears together with the target item without implying causation.
The source stream or set is filtered using the target rule or mechanism.
The source entity received its name in reference to the target entity.

role.description: Select the source-side endpoint that originates, provides, or performs the requested relation.
train_phrases: which record is doing the relational work
heldout_phrases: which participant is on the source side

role.description: Select the receiving target-side endpoint reached or acted on by the requested relation.
train_phrases: which record is on the receiving side

role.description: Preserve both endpoints equally because neither endpoint is the requested directional winner.
train_phrases: keep the two endpoints as a co-valid pair
heldout_phrases: treat both sides as equally valid
do not choose a directional winner

role.description: No relational endpoint role should be selected because the request is fallback, deferred, or ungrounded.
train_phrases: preserve uncertainty instead of choosing an endpoint
heldout_phrases: there is no grounded endpoint role

traversal.description: Use one local relation and select its requested endpoint rather than following a multi-step route or combining many links.
train_phrases: which record is reached by that relationship
select the endpoint of the link

traversal.description: Follow an ordered sequence of relation steps from a focused starting or ending endpoint.
train_phrases: first use one relationship then another
heldout_phrases: walk the relation chain in order

traversal.description: Consider multiple matching links or endpoints together and preserve, combine, or arbitrate among them.

direction.description: Traverse from a relation source toward its target in the relation's forward direction.
train_phrases: begin at the source and move to the target

direction.description: Traverse backward from a relation target toward its source.
Treat both directions or both endpoints as valid without imposing one directed traversal.
train_phrases: do not impose a directional winner

control.description: The request does not need relational execution and should pass through to the base non-relational path.
train_phrases: the request is ordinary non-relational interpretation
heldout_phrases: use the base path instead of relation execution

control.description: The request is grounded in the supplied relation schema and should execute relational reasoning.
heldout_phrases: the query has a grounded relation

control.description: Relational intent exists or may exist but the available schema or request is insufficient, so preserve uncertainty and defer.
train_phrases: the requested relationship is not supplied
heldout_phrases: defer because the schema cannot ground the relation
do not force an unsupported relation

modifiers.on_description: Prefer stronger reliability, provenance, or verification when multiple relation paths remain valid.
modifiers.off_description: Do not use reliability or verification as an arbitration criterion for this request.
heldout_off: ignore reliability as a selection factor

modifiers.on_description: Prefer the latest applicable state or most recent valid relation when multiple candidates remain.
modifiers.off_description: Do not use recency or latest-state preference for this request.
heldout_off: do not use recency as a criterion

modifiers.on_description: Require that a relation satisfy the request's stated time window or temporal scope.
modifiers.off_description: No explicit time-window constraint should filter relation support.
train_on: only one is valid for the time window
heldout_off: do not apply a temporal filter

modifiers.on_description: Require that a relation come from the provenance class authorized by the request.
modifiers.off_description: No provenance-class constraint should filter relation support.
heldout_on: filter by the authorized provenance class
heldout_off: do not apply a provenance-class filter
